name: rgb2ycbcr
expr: y8 = rgb2ycbcr(R8); y16 = rgb2ycbcr(R16); yd = rgb2ycbcr(Rd);
comment: MATLAB rgb2ycbcr — RGB->YCbCr (BT.601), class-preserving across uint8 / uint16 / double. uint8 in -> uint8 out studio range (Y in [16,235], Cb/Cr in [16,240]); uint16 in -> uint16 out (scaled by 65535); double in -> double studio swing in [0,1]. Pins Y/Cb/Cr values at two pixels for all three classes. Bit-equal MATLAB R2025b (tol=1e-9). Octave ships it in image pkg only.
